releaseNotes.zh-Hans: 修复 Android 系统手势导航栏区域仍显示黑底的问题。应用现在在 Flutter 启动层、Android 主题和 MainActivity 恢复生命周期中统一设置白色系统导航栏、深色手势/导航图标，并关闭系统导航栏对比度强制阴影。已通过 Flutter 全量测试、Android release 构建校验和 vivo 真机覆盖安装截图验证。
releaseNotes.zh-Hant: 修復 Android 系統手勢導覽列區域仍顯示黑底的問題。應用現在在 Flutter 啟動層、Android 主題和 MainActivity 恢復生命週期中統一設定白色系統導覽列、深色手勢/導覽圖示，並關閉系統導覽列對比度強制陰影。已通過 Flutter 全量測試、Android release 建置校驗和 vivo 真機覆蓋安裝截圖驗證。
releaseNotes.en: Fix the Android system gesture navigation area still falling back to a black background. The app now sets a white system navigation bar with dark gesture/navigation icons from Flutter startup, Android themes, and MainActivity resume, and disables the Android navigation contrast scrim. Verified with the full Flutter test suite, Android release build checks, and a vivo real-device overwrite install screenshot.
